query: SELECT message.id, message.role, message.content, message.action_id, message.trigger_sequence_id, inference.sequence_id AS inference_sequence_id FROM world_member AS member JOIN player_character ON player_character.member_id = member.id JOIN agent_history ON agent_history.agent_id = player_character.agent_id JOIN history_entry ON history_entry.branch_id = agent_history.branch_id JOIN message ON message.id = history_entry.id LEFT JOIN inference ON inference.id = message.source_inference_id WHERE member.id = ? AND member.world_id = ? AND member.user_id = ? AND player_character.character_id = ? AND player_character.agent_id = ? AND member.access = 'active' AND message.id > ? AND message.origin = 'conversation' ORDER BY history_entry.position
